requested_order.text: Wegovy (semaglutide) 0.25 mg SC once weekly x4 weeks, then titrate per label to 2.4 mg weekly

weight_management_program.text:
A/P:
1. Obesity, BMI 31.0 — plan starting today:
 - Reduced-calorie meal plan of about 1400 kcal/day with food logging in a phone app.
 - Stationary bike 30–40 minutes 4 days a week.
 - Enrolled in the clinic's Healthy Weight lifestyle program.
 Follow-up in ~3 months.
2. Low back pain — stable.

PRIMARY CARE PROGRESS NOTE
Date: 05/12/2026
S: Follow-up. Continues the meal plan and bike routine started in February; logs most days, bikes 3–4x/week. Good adherence most weeks.
O: Wt 81.4 kg, BMI 30.6. BP 109/73.
A/P:
1. Obesity — continue program.

PRIMARY CARE PROGRESS NOTE
Date: 08/18/2026
S: Follow-up. Continues the diet and activity plan started in February — logging, bike most weeks. Frustrated: weight 79.7 kg today vs 82.4 kg when the lifestyle plan began (-3.3%), and it has stalled despite reported adherence. Sinusitis resolved. Asks about medication. No MTC/MEN2 history, no pancreatitis. Postmenopausal.
O: Wt 79.7 kg, Ht 163 cm, BMI 30.0. BP 112/66.

PHARMACIST MEDICATION REVIEW — 03/17/2025
Pt asked about black cohosh for hot flashes and a sleep aid (diphenhydramine). Black cohosh — limited evidence, rare liver effects; diphenhydramine not advised long term at her age; with sertraline — no major interaction but additive drowsiness. Suggested discussing hot flashes with PCP.
